searchText: I've found that lowering `SECONDS_PER_DAY` is useful for reducing the lag between eth1 genesis and eth2 genesis (usually 1-2 days). It seems so wrong, but it feels so right. I was thinking it would be nice if this constant was dedicated to that lag instead of being generic about the seconds in a day. E.g., `MIN_GENESIS_DELAY_PERIOD` or something like that. This way it would continue to feel so right, but wouldn't seem so wrong. Just pretend genesis is on Jupiter https://spaceplace.nasa.gov/days/en/ I like it! I was thinking more about 15 mins or something... perhaps there's an astroid somewhere we can target instead? good thinking > I was thinking it would be nice if this constant was dedicated to that lag instead of being generic about the seconds in a day. E.g., MIN_GENESIS_DELAY_PERIOD or something like that. I agree with this
